intersections.note: Derby runs east only (cemetery west of Winton)
the north-south leg of S. Circle Av. ends at Derby; Derby continues east to the sheet edge
Station comes from the south and ends at S. Circle

S. Circle Av. turns here: its east-west leg ends against the north-south street, which is labelled S. CIRCLE AV. north of this point and MAPLE AV. south of it (one straight 42 ft street, west face x 5495, east face x 5755). Rounded block corner (lots 29-31) on the north-west side
Euclid comes from the east and ends at Station; Station continues south off the sheet (to sheet 647)
Maple ends at Euclid from the north; Euclid continues east to the sheet edge

notes: Single panel. Winton R'd (60 ft) down the left side, Spring Grove Cemetery west of it. Derby Av. (42 ft) along the top, S. Circle Av. (printed S. CIRCLE, 42 ft; name expanded to South Circle Avenue) across the middle, Euclid Av. (40 ft) at the bottom right from Station to the east edge. Station Av. (40 ft) runs south from S. Circle. The north-south street on the right (x about 5625) is labelled S. CIRCLE AV. between Derby and S. Circle and MAPLE AV. (42 ft) between S. Circle and Euclid; S. Circle is an L-shaped street turning the corner at (5626, 4278). Station's printed width is 40 ft; Maple's printed width (42 ft) appears at Euclid. No alleys; the inner lines are lot lines.
